name: FS.COM Limited
summary: FS.COM Limited provides DTC networking solutions to computing, data centers, enterprise networks, and telecommunications industry in China and internationally. It offers enterprise, data center, PoE+, small business, and industrial ethernet switches and accessories; bare metal switches and software; router, security, and network packet broker products; optical transceivers; fiber optic cables; fiber optic panels, cassettes, and enclosures; and cable manager products, racks and cabinets, and labels and printers.
